rationale:
Issue #143 ('Crash in SSHChildChannel') reports a fatal error 'Sent channel window adjust on channel in invalid state' from ChildChannelStateMachine.sendChannelWindowAdjust when inbound data forces a window adjustment after the channel was closed locally, and the reporter pins it to commit c56ababb0e22e0cdf5ec8b31698e07f943ea92e7, which is exactly the recorded buggy_revision. The minimized production patch is a single hunk in Sources/NIOSSH/Child Channels/SSHChildChannel.swift that tightens an already-existing guard from '!self.didClose' to '!self.didClose, !self.state.sentClose' before constructing and sending the channelWindowAdjust message; original_hunk_count=1, retained_hunks=[1], removed_hunk_count=0, and no formatting, doc, config, or API additions accompany it. Because the patch adds no new declarations, self.state.sentClose is pre-existing internal state, so the trigger does not rely on an API introduced by the fix. The trigger test testWeDontResizeTheWindowAfterLocalClosing is the unchanged upstream test from the same fixing commit and reproduces the reported scenario at the same abstraction level: it opens a child channel with autoRead disabled, closes it locally, delivers inbound data large enough to require a window adjustment, then calls read() and asserts no additional outbound message is flushed (count stays at 2), which is precisely the forbidden window-adjust-after-local-close path from the stack trace. Machine-generated strict evidence passes all gates both originally and post-minimization: build.both_versions, selectors.present_and_unique (1 unique selector), trigger.buggy_differential reproducing exactly ChildChannelMultiplexerTests::testWeDontResizeTheWindowAfterLocalClosing, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (3 fingerprint groups over 3 repetitions), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, and full_suite.fixed_all_green with no failed_checks. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause duplicates no registry entry, and apple/swift-nio-ssh#143 is the sole allowed verified issue key with traceability path fix_commit_to_issue.

Issue #143 reports a fatal error 'Sent channel window adjust on channel in invalid state' with a stack trace through ChildChannelStateMachine.sendChannelWindowAdjust, reported against commit c56ababb0e22e0cdf5ec8b31698e07f943ea92e7 — exactly the recorded buggy_revision. The minimized production patch is a single one-line change in Sources/NIOSSH/Child Channels/SSHChildChannel.swift that tightens an already-existing guard (!self.didClose) with !self.state.sentClose before emitting channelWindowAdjust, which directly prevents the state-machine precondition the issue trips. No refactor, formatting, feature, doc, or config change is present; original_hunk_count=1, retained=1, removed=0, and the production-fix patch is byte-identical to the minimized one. The trigger test testWeDontResizeTheWindowAfterLocalClosing is the unchanged upstream test from the same single-commit PR #144 and reproduces the reported scenario semantically: local close, then inbound data large enough to require a window adjustment, then read(), asserting no additional outbound messages. It references only pre-existing test-harness and public API surface (createChildChannel, autoRead option, close(promise:), receiveMessage, read(), assertChannelOpen, openConfirmation, data, ByteBuffer.bigBuffer) and does not touch the internal state.sentClose flag used by the fix, so it depends on no API introduced by the fix; build.both_versions passing confirms it compiles against the buggy revision. Strict evidence passes on both the original and post-minimization runs: single unique selector, buggy differential reproducing exactly the declared trigger, deterministic across 3 repetitions with 3 fingerprint groups, fixed isolated/suite/reversed runs clean, and fixed full suite all green with no baseline exclusions. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this window-adjust-after-local-close root cause is not a duplicate of any active registry entry.
